A '''military supervisor''' oversaw a team of [[O'reenian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at an [[Unidentified analysis center|analysis center]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Orbital Deployment Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]]. When the team received a piece of stolen military hardware to analyze, the supervisor eventually received orders to ship the item on to the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Fort Maximus]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
